title: Enterprise Support: Handling conditions for retained-fee authorization
content:
Enterprise Support — Handling conditions for retained-fee authorization.

## Handling condition

For retained-fee authorization: Before calculating the retain-one-fee refund authorization, the paid support rate-error credit for the selected source invoice must be posted so the current account surplus reflects the corrected bill.

For retained-fee authorization: This paid rate-error reconciliation applies to full-month, on-demand standard US East source service with approved negotiated support terms and reviewed US untaxed tax treatment. Support service records retain the already official compute export physical quantities for the exact source support invoice; they carry no financial posting. Other products confer no support discount.
